title: Similar HR Benefits Snapshot Reconciliation
goal: Extract the archived employee benefits census from a PDF and compare it with the current Excel enrollment workbook to report removed employees, benefit-plan tier changes, dependent-count changes, and salary-band updates.
skillBenefitRationale: 保留了源任务的核心路径：从多页 PDF 表格中抽取历史员工记录，再对当前 XLSX 数据做字段级比对，并保持数值与文本类型处理的要求。
